row.evidence: GUIDEcx's pricing page offers "Single Sign-On (SSO) for Premium and Advanced users" and its SSO guide adds SAML JIT ("Enabling JIT will allow you to create new users automatically as they login through your IdP"); no SCIM appears on the pricing page, in the help centre or in the Open API.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. All three plans (Starter, Premium, Advanced) are 'Speak to Sales', so price fields are null; paid licences are Admin, Manager and Guide, other internal and external users are free. No SCIM by absence (medium): pricing page, all 267 help-centre articles in the sitemap and the Open API 3.0 swagger were checked. SAML SSO (Premium+) is enabled by contacting GUIDEcx; JIT creates users as Contributors on first login; deactivation ('Remove Access') is manual and users cannot be deleted. The Open API (bearer token, Premium package per the pricing page) only searches members and roles and removes project members; there is no user create or deactivate endpoint. No GUIDEcx app in the Okta OIN or Entra gallery; SAML uses custom apps.

scim.notes: No SCIM on the pricing page, in any of the 267 help-centre articles (sitemap) or in the Open API 3.0 swagger; false is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: Bearer token generated by an Admin; keys can be scoped to permissions and resources.

capabilities.notes: No user create, update or deactivate endpoints in the 35-path swagger; roles can only be searched.

endpoints.purpose: Remove a member from a project team

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook event types in the swagger cover projects, milestones and tasks only.

limitations.text: The API cannot create, deactivate or delete users.

okta.notes: No OIN app; generic SAML app.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial (guidecx-tutorial 404); generic SAML.

google.notes: Custom SAML app per vendor guide.
